discussion_comments.comment_body:
- Using client width/height was the main culprit of that size twitching during zoom (as they are rounded)
- The ResizeObserver gives us precise measurements anyway

One thing we aren't doing is we aren't cleaning up the <style> element we create

I'm erring on the side of not doing that since shaders may be mounted/unmounted on the same page conditionally (e.g. for hover interactions and what not), and removing/adding `<style>` every time is not the cheapest operation. We'd also need to assign an ID to each shader and track if all shaders have been disposed...
